parameters.name: planning_horizon_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the horizon

parameters.name: period_set
parameters.description: Ordered set of planning periods indexed from 0 to T-1

parameters.name: purchase_price
parameters.description: Unit purchase price in each period

parameters.name: sale_price
parameters.description: Unit sale price in each period

parameters.name: max_sales_volume
parameters.description: Maximum sales volume in each period

variables.name: purchase_quantity
variables.description: Quantity purchased at the beginning of each period

variables.name: ending_inventory
variables.description: Inventory remaining at the end of each period

variables.name: age_tracked_sales
variables.description: Quantity purchased in period tau and sold in period t, defined only for valid pairs with tau <= t

constraints.name: nonnegative_inventory_and_flows
constraints.description: Purchase, sales, inventory, and age-tracked sales quantities are nonnegative.
constraints.formula: x_t \geq 0,\; y_t \geq 0,\; I_t \geq 0,\; z_{t,\tau} \geq 0 \quad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall \tau \in \mathcal{T},\; \tau \leq t

constraints.name: lower_triangular_age_tracking
constraints.description: Age-tracked sales are defined only for valid period pairs where the purchase period is not later than the sale period.

constraints.name: integrality_if_required
constraints.description: Decision quantities are treated as continuous nonnegative quantities in the baseline because integrality is not required by the problem statement.
constraints.formula: x_t \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0},\; y_t \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0},\; I_t \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0},\; z_{t,\tau} \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0} \quad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall \tau \in \mathcal{T},\; \tau \le t

constraints.name: warehouse_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Inventory held in the warehouse cannot exceed the storage capacity in any period.

constraints.name: sales_volume_limit
constraints.description: Sales in each period cannot exceed the period-specific maximum sales volume.

constraints.name: inventory_flow_consistency
constraints.description: Inventory must follow period-by-period flow consistency between purchases, sales, and carried inventory.
constraints.formula: I_t = I_{t-1} + x_t - y_t \quad \forall t=0,\dots,T-1,\; I_{-1}=I_0

constraints.name: age_based_storage_cost_tracking
constraints.description: Storage cost is represented directly in the objective through age-tracked quantities, with cost increasing linearly by age.

constraints.name: final_inventory_cleared
constraints.description: All remaining inventory must be cleared by the end of the final period, matching the required ending inventory at the horizon end.

objectives.name: total_annual_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total annual profit from timber purchases, sales, and storage

final_objective.description: Maximize total annual profit from timber purchases, sales, and age-dependent storage costs.
final_objective.formula: Z = \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} c_t^{\mathrm{sell}} y_t - \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} c_t^{\mathrm{buy}} x_t - \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} \sum_{\tau=0}^{t} \left(a + b(t-\tau)\right) z_{t,\tau}
